A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the most important risk factor for stroke after cardiac surgery is a previous history of stroke.
the risk of early stroke after cardiac surgery is associated with preoperative factors, while delayed stroke is associated with perioperative factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the risk of stroke after cardiac surgery is not a simple linear function of the number of risk factors a patient has, but is rather an exponential function of the number and type of risk factors a person has.
